## Scope

The audit reviewed a sample of 495 graded sets. Each set was read again by a second grader to assess consistency between the original and repeat grading. The review considered whether the first and second grades agreed for each set. This approach provides a direct check of grading agreement within the audited sample. It does not replace the underlying grading process or provide a separate assessment of individual grader performance.

Per-grader results are recorded in the attached spreadsheet. These results are discussed privately with each grader.

## Result

First and second grades agreed in 65.7 per cent of sets reviewed. The result summarises agreement across the sample and should be read alongside the per-grader information in the attached spreadsheet. That information supports follow-up discussion with each grader and helps identify any matters requiring attention.
